description: This Java source file defines the ReadRecInd class, representing a specific type of MMS PDU (Protocol Data Unit) used for read receipt indications within the Android MMS library. It contains constructors, getters, and setters for header fields related to read receipt messages.

classes.name: ReadRecInd
classes.description: Represents the MMS Read Receipt Indication PDU, encapsulating headers like message ID, sender, recipient list, date, and read status.

methods.name: ReadRecInd
methods.description: Constructor used when creating a new read receipt indication PDU with specific header values.

methods.name: ReadRecInd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with existing header data.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date associated with the read receipt.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date for the read receipt.

methods.name: getMessageId
methods.description: Returns the message ID associated with the PDU.

methods.name: setMessageId
methods.description: Sets the message ID for the PDU.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Retrieves the list of recipient addresses.

methods.name: setReadStatus
methods.description: Sets the read status indicator, may throw an exception if invalid.
